description:
The Xenon Pro XXL rounds out the range with Pro XXL geometry and a full specification upgrade, giving taller riders access to the same race-focused performance found throughout the Xenon line. Disc-ready as standard, it can easily be upgraded to a full disc brake setup using our aftermarket conversion kit.
Featuring forged disc-ready dropouts with integrated tensioners, our Xenon stem, Tioga Power Block tires, and Argon Pro rims, the Xenon Pro XXL is built with racing in mind from the ground up. Fast, dependable, and ready to line up, it's designed to help riders perform at their best every time the gate drops.

FRAME: hydroformed 6061-T6 alloy frame, tapered headtube, forged & disc brake mount ready dropouts, with int. chaintensioners

STEM: ARISE "XENON PRO" toploader stem, ext. 53mm, cold forged/cnc alloy

crmo fork, 1-1/8" butted steerer, crmo fork legs, 30mm offset
